profile.summary: Overaa Construction is a general contractor based in Richmond, California. It provides preconstruction services, general contracting and collaborative delivery, including lease-leaseback contracts, on projects such as schools, healthcare buildings, water infrastructure and commercial buildings across Northern California.

review.notes: Overaa's contact and about pages confirm legal name C. Overaa & Co., the Richmond CA headquarters, phone, generic email and address; its Roosevelt Middle School page names OUSD as owner with lease-leaseback delivery, matching the agenda items. The summary is neutral and its services and sectors match the About page; 'Northern California' and lease-leaseback come from the project pages and office locations rather than the cited About page, but are consistent with them.
